title: GLM can finish a response with native search starts lacking result receipts
wanted_capability: Distinguish completed provider-native search results from proposals whose execution status remains unknown; do not infer executions from starts or declare native completion consistency passed without matching receipts.
fallback_used: Retain raw native blocks and explicitly mark the probe inconclusive; paired result counts include provider errors and are not successful-execution counts.
evidence: 2026-09-07 broad flagship live suite request007: native max_uses5, ten distinct starts, five matching results, five unmatched IDs, successful terminal response
notes: Discovered during duplicate-execution containment validation. All ten queries concern requested Python documentation, so this is not evidence of unrelated spurious searching.
